topic: Your Phone's Brain Works on Tiny Lightning
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Your phone's brain works on tiny lightning bolts! ⚡️🤯

💡 Your phone's chip has billions of transistors acting like light switches, flipping billions of times per second, creating miniature lightning signals for processing.
